Hear from our happy customers

I confidently recommend the Scout platform for any school who provides an independent study learning model. The development team at Scout demonstrates a solid understanding of the extensive rules and legalities of independent study and works to embed these complex compliance requirements into every aspect of the platform.

Beyond compliance, they are incredibly responsive to feedback and authentically interested in maximizing efficiency for our administrators and teaching staff. Their commitment is perfectly captured by something I've heard them say repeatedly: if it's still extra work for you, then we still have work to do.

Kelly Haight

Principal

Hearthstone School

As the director of an independent study program in southern California, Scout has proven to be one of our most valuable partners. They help us pull data from our multiple curriculum partners into one easy-to-use platform, allowing us to support our students to the fullest.

More importantly, the team at Scout is easy to work with and willing to innovate alongside us to ensure that our needs are met.

We simply couldn't be the innovative program that we are without them!

Dr. Robert Walker

Director

iGranada

Transitioning to Scout has been nothing short of revolutionary for our independent study hybrid charter school.

Managing over 1,000 students across five learning centers requires precision, and Scout has streamlined everything from student records to state reporting and audits.

Despite the complexity of our personalized TK-12 model, the platform has saved us countless hours already in overseeing student engagement and work, documenting attendance, and communicating with families.

Their team is knowledgeable, responsive, and constantly exceeding our expectations.

We built Scout for the schools reimagining what education means. For the educators fighting for a seat at the table. For the students on their unique learning journeys, off the beaten path.

Read the manifesto

Expert assistance, any time of day.

Experience support designed for your success. Our expert engineers, with deep knowledge of Scout, respond in under an hour, wherever you communicate: Teams, Slack, email, WhatsApp, you name it. Forget endless escalations; get direct access and rapid solutions.

Plus, we build the features you need, collaboratively and quickly - often in days, not months - ensuring Scout evolves with you.

Best-in-class data security.

Protecting your school's sensitive information is our top priority. Scout employs modern security practices, including advanced encryption protocols, multi-factor authentication, and regular security updates to ensure your data is always secure.

We comply with all federal and state regulations, including FERPA, COPPA, and California's data requirements (SOPIPA), to safeguard student records and personal information.
